items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: Jim was kind enough to get me an invitation there.

ctx.x: Yeah. And during this time when you were making 'Buck and the Preacher' and this TV film about Louis, you were getting involved in a number of other universities aside from Princeton, of course, when Jim Patrick went up to Cornell, in the music department there, you held some seminars and also played a concert there.
Jim was kind enough to get me an invitation there.
Do you remember when that was? Exactly?
